findings.message: Risk information is incomplete (roof_condition) but the risk was priced as eligible.
findings.expectedValue: AWAITING_INFORMATION decision until the questionnaire is complete
findings.observedValue: eligible quotes: QTE-2026-00009; active policies: POL-2026-00005
findings.remediation: Place the case on hold, collect the missing risk data, then re-evaluate.

findings.message: Policy end date is not after its start date.
findings.remediation: Correct the term end date and re-issue the schedule.

findings.message: Policy bound by APPLICANT without a recorded underwriting approval.
findings.expectedValue: APPROVED underwriting decision by an authorized reviewer
findings.remediation: Escalate to a risk reviewer; reverse the binding if approval is not granted.

findings.message: Policy is ACTIVE while premium is unpaid.
findings.remediation: Suspend the policy until payment is received, or record the payment reference.

findings.message: Coverage overlaps POL-2026-00002 for asset AST-2026-00011; the overlap is not explained by a recorded replacement.
findings.remediation: Cancel or amend one policy and record the reason as an endorsement.

findings.message: Stored gross premium differs from the deterministic pricing formula.
findings.remediation: Re-run the pricing engine; do not hand-edit premium values.

findings.message: Coverage PRP-FIR limit 2500000.00 is outside the permitted range.
findings.remediation: Reduce the limit to the configured maximum or refer for a bespoke facility.

findings.message: Renewal exists for cancelled policy POL-2026-00001.
findings.expectedValue: renewal only for ACTIVE or EXPIRED policies
findings.remediation: Withdraw the renewal offer and document the case.
